covered with, veiled in (instr.), MBh.
dependent on (instr.), Mn.; MBh. &c.
relating to, contained in (loc.), MBh.; Hariv.
composed or consisting of accompanied by, furnished with, adorned or inlaid with (comp.), Mn.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
shut up, closed, obstructed, Kathās.
constructed, built, ib.
composed, written down, R.; Kālid. &c.
used, employed as a word, Sāh.
called as a witness (अ-न्˚, Mn. viii, 76)
confined costive, W.
committed, intrusted, MW.
नि-˚बद्ध m. (in music) a partic. instrument.
नि-˚बद्धव्य (!) mfn. necessarily connected with (instr.), Sāh.

chain, fetter, bondage, MBh.; BhP.
attachment to, intentness on L.
basis, root, origin, MBh. ii, 2532
a grant of property, an assignment of cattle or money, Yājñ. i, 317
fixed property, ib. ii, 121
restraint, obstruction, L.
constipation or suppression of urine, Suśr. (v.l. for वि-ब्˚)
any literary composition or work, Cat.

Azadirachta Indica, L.

नि-˚बन्धन n. tying, fastening, binding together, ligation, Mn.; Suśr.
holding fast, restraining, MBh.; Kāv. &c.

seat, receptacle (cf. इषु-न्˚)

a commentary

नि-˚बन्धनीय mfn. good or friendly relation

नि-बाध See अ-निबाध॑.

नि-बिड mf(आ)n. or नि-विड (prob. fr. बिड = बिल, a hole; cf. नि-खिल) without spaces or interstices, close, compact, thick, dense, firm, MBh.; Kāv. &c. full of abounding in (instr. or comp.), Hariv.; Śak. vii, 11 (v.l. for नि-चित)
low, Kād.
crooked-nosed, Pāṇ. v, 2, 32, Kāś.
नि-बिड m. N. of a mountain, MBh. vi, 460
नि-बिड n. crooked-nosedness, Pāṇ. v, 2, 32, Kāś.
निबिडय Nom. P. ˚यति, to make tight, embrace firmly, Bālar. ii, 62.
निबि˚डित mfn. made tight, become thick or heavy, Mālatīm.
pressed close to, Bālar. v, 19.
निबिडी-√ कृ to make tight or firm, bend (a bow), Vcar.
निबिरीश mfn. = नि-बिड, Kāv. (-नि-तम्ब, Śiś. vii, 20), Pāṇ. v, 2, 32, Kāś. (W. निविडीष).
नि-˚बोद्धव्य mfn. to be learnt
to be regarded or considered as (with nomin.), Var.
नि-˚बोद्धृ mfn. knowing, wise, Gal.
नि-बुसी-कृत mfn. freed from chaff, husked, Kuval. (cf. निर्-ब्˚).

नि-√ बृह् (वृह्) P. -बृहति (aor. -बर्हीत्), to throw down, overthrow, crush, destroy, RV. :

नि-˚बर्हित mfn. destroyed, removed
नि-˚बर्हि˚तांहस् mfn. destroying sin, Śiś. i, 29.
